ruleset.name: nitpicker-reactor
ruleset.description: Nitpicker Reactor rules: no blocking calls on the threads that run a reactive chain.

rule.name: ReactorBlockingInOperator
rule.message: Move this blocking call off the Reactor event loop: wrap it as Mono.fromCallable(() -> blocking()).subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic()) inside flatMap, or add publishOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic()) earlier in the chain, or use a non-blocking client. A blocking call inside an operator runs on the thread that serves every other request, so it stalls them all until it returns.

rule.name: ReactorBlockInReactiveMethod
rule.message: Return the inner publisher through flatMap or zipWith instead of calling block(). This method returns a Mono or Flux, so its caller runs on an event-loop thread, where block() stalls every other request (Reactor throws IllegalStateException on those threads).
